body:
versionCode: 139

### Whats New (09-29-25 Build)

  - bump versionCode
  - settings fragment: fix ThunderHub card shown in Settings
  - Update nightly.sh
  - nightly.sh: dynamically count how many commits were pushed since the last build date and pull that amount
  - nightly.sh: programmatically count how many characters the git log is and apply it to the character limit
  - build.gradle: update 6 libraries
  - Update nightly.sh
  - changelog xml: fix changelog body margins
  - settings xml: improve layout (increase texture opacity, adjust margins for settings title and thunderhub)
  - nightly.sh: increase changelog character limit in discord
  - Changelog Activity and XML: attempt to fix text cutoff for large parsed changelogs
  - build.gradle / nightly.sh: bump default versionCode and versionName
  - nightly.sh: increase commits pulled amount, remove explanation section, replace with improved comments throughout the script
  - news and updates xml: improve date (increase text size, fix margins and paddings)
  - Update NewsUpdateAdapter.java
  - News and Updates adapter: improve logic on when to apply black text or white for the dynamic date background text, punch date text opacity up
  - improve README.md
  - news and updates list: adjust margins, remove cardview elevation, adjust text size for title
  - News and Updates Adapter: improve code structure and code comments
  - News and Updates UI improvement: add a colored background with dynamic palette colors behind news and updates text
  - NewsUpdatesAdapter.java: add slight transparency to dynamic palette background pill
  - News and Updates xml: greatly improve UI and margins
  - news and updates: fix margins to tighten up the text and dynamic background
  - improve margins for the textview pill for groups
  - new aircraft machine guns image
  - new aircraft cannons image
  - vehicle group xml: improve the UI (reduce vertical and horizontal margins so text pill background doesnt take up as much space)
  - vehicles group: replace helis image with a better one
  - NEW: aircraft cannons image
  - format GroupedWeaponryFragment.java
  - VehicleGroupFragment.java: clean up code and remove unused variables
  - Vehicles Group: NEW and improved zoom animation
  - fix typo from last commit, scaleStart was 1.9 when it needs to be 1 xD
  - VehiclesGroup.java: adjust zoom margins, slightly reduce zoom animation time
  - vehicle groups: adjust tank margins (picture was too high with included bottom margin, bottom margin removed)
  - new tank image for grouped ammo fragment (+ reduce app size)
  - NEW: vehicle group images
  - remove unused static star gradient background
